🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive; leadership is Broad (4 sectors in the Top 5), but breadth at zero and negative Financials and Industrials independently confirm broad weakness. Relative resilience in staples and utilities is not enough to offset the decline.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples, Utilities and Communication are the relative leaders, though all have negative 1W sector averages. Staples: KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%); Utilities: SO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +4.05%); Communication: DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +7.53%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest by sector average, with NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -34.23%) and ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -13.01% | 1M: -14.37%). Energy and Materials also lag: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -10.20%) and FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -18.74% | 1M: -28.71%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%), TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +10.67%), TJX RECOVERY (1W: +2.52% | 1M: -3.86%), DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +7.53%), SO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +4.05%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in the Top 5), but the market-wide breadth remains weak.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.22% | 1M: -27.23%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -11.84% | 1M: -39.42%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -34.23%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.55% | 1M: -9.02%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -21.90%). Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with Industrials also represented.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%), TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +10.67%) and TJX RECOVERY (1W: +2.52% | 1M: -3.86%). Major divergence across large stocks—including AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +1.59%) and LLY CORRECTION (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +6.45%)—makes this transitional; watch for a trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak: the sector average is BELOW TREND (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -14.66%); sector stock-level breadth is unavailable in the supplied data. NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -34.23%) and MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.54% | 1M: -6.32%) contrast with PANW RECOVERY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: -0.11%).

8. Financials Outlook?
The sector average is BELOW TREND (1W: -4.51% | 1M: -2.68%); sector stock-level breadth is unavailable. JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -4.47%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -1.19%) and MA CORRECTION (1W: -4.00% | 1M: +0.62%) show broad pressure with some longer-term divergence.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
The sector average is BELOW TREND (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -1.92%); sector stock-level breadth is unavailable. UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -20.75%) and PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -6.39%) are weak, while JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -5.78% | 1M: +3.63%) and LLY CORRECTION (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +6.45%) retain positive 1M returns.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor resilience over high-beta exposure while breadth remains 0/11; monitor staples and utilities for relative strength, but note their sector averages are still negative. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; the data do not confirm a clean Growth-versus-Value leadership call.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +7.53%), with positive guidance and dividend news; monitor for continued price confirmation. BEARISH: AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -16.42% | 1M: -11.49%) and UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -20.75%); watch whether negative momentum and sentiment persist.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples and Utilities are relative leaders, but their sector averages remain in CORRECTION and breadth is 0/11 overall. BEARISH: Technology is BELOW TREND (sector average 1W: -8.68% | 1M: -14.66%); Energy is also BELOW TREND (1W: -6.03% | 1M: -11.91%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not provided, so numeric support and resistance cannot be assessed. Monitor whether NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -34.23%) and CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.22% | 1M: -27.23%) losses moderate, and whether DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +7.53%) sustains its advance.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DIS (+75): dividend increase and double-digit EPS growth outlook; ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +7.53%), sentiment confirmed by price. PANW (+50): results supported ARR confidence; RECOVERY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: -0.11%), a short-term bounce with monthly confirmation still needed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
FCX (-45): analyst downgrade; BELOW TREND (1W: -18.74% | 1M: -28.71%), sentiment confirmed. AMD (-35): short-seller concerns accompany a sharp decline; BELOW TREND (1W: -16.42% | 1M: -11.49%), confirmed; UNH (-35): policy concerns coincide with BELOW TREND price action (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -20.75%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with 0/11 sectors positive and Broad leadership among the small set of top performers; style is mixed with no clear leadership. KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) and DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +7.53%) show relative strength. Major 1W/1M divergences warrant caution, while negative sentiment alongside weakness in FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -18.74% | 1M: -28.71%) reinforces downside risk.
